# Seniority Level

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:SeniorityLevel`](gmeow-SeniorityLevel.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/SeniorityLevel>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/employment`](../../slices/employment.md)

The seniority or rank of an employment — a VALUE, never an [`Employment`](gmeow-Employment.md) subclass. The set is open; a level not among the seeds is a FRESH [`gmeow:SeniorityLevel`](gmeow-SeniorityLevel.md) individual carrying [rdfs:label.](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label.) Pointed at by [`gmeow:employmentSeniority`](../properties/gmeow-employmentSeniority.md). Orthogonal to employment type and role.
